Maria Alvarez: Hi team — kicking off onboarding for Apollo Diagnostics. Quick context: integrating Redwood for in-app triage + anonymized embeddings. Primary goals are stable latency < 200ms p50, and admin enablement by end of week. Meeting at 2pm PT to align.
Jake Chen: Thanks Maria. Who are the tech leads on their side?
Maria Alvarez: @Jake Chen they have two SMEs: Sophia (integration lead) and Raj (data infra). Sophia will be in this thread.
Sophia Patel: hey all — yep that's me. We're expecting ~500 concurrent sessions at peak. Main concern is prefix caching and auth.
Liam O'Connor: noted on concurrency. We'll pair Sophia with infra during the first integration sprint. Can we confirm SLOs and success criteria?
Maria Alvarez: Success criteria (high level):
```
- p50 latency <200ms on typical convo (8 tokens/sec load)
- No auth errors >0.1% during integration tests
- Admins can run embeddings export + rerank by EOW
- 1 person trained on console + runbook handed off
```
Jake Chen: timeline proposal: Week 0: infra access + test creds, Week 1: integration spike, Week 2: load test + tune, Week 3: enablement + handoff. Any blockers to that?
Sophia Patel: Raj needs a VPC peering window next Wed. Also compliance needs an NDA amendment for data retention longer than 30d.
Maria Alvarez: Adding blockers: VPC peering, NDA amendment. I'll loop in Legal after this thread.
Liam O'Connor: Action items:
- Sophia: share traffic profile + sample payloads by EOD Tue
- Jake: provision sandbox + API keys by Wed morning
- Maria: start NDA amendment ticket and schedule legal sync
- Liam: prep runbook draft and enablement deck
OnboardBot: Kickoff checklist created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/3105001234 — checklist added: sandbox, keys, runbook, enablement call
Sophia Patel: I'll upload payloads to the shared folder and ping Raj.
Jake Chen: Sandbox creds requested, will post when ready.
Maria Alvarez: One more note on renewal risk: their procurement timeline is tight — if we miss admin enablement by end of week 3, they may push decision. Flagged as medium risk. Let's keep daily sync for first 10 days.
Liam O'Connor: Agreed — daily 15m stand for first 2 weeks. I'll send calendar invites.
Sophia Patel: confirmed. thanks everyone :)
Maria Alvarez: Thanks — see you at 2pm PT. Minutes + recording will be posted after the call.
